panels.title: Workload Usage (CPU & Memory by Pod / Namespace)

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$node"}[5m]))
sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$node"})
sum by (cluster, namespace) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$node"}[5m]))
sum by (cluster, namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$node"})

sum by (instance) (label_replace(kube_node_status_capacity{resource="cpu", unit="core", cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) - sum by (instance) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$node"}[5m]))

panels.title: CPU usage by Node, all clusters, top 20

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (label_replace(kube_node_status_capacity{resource="memory", unit="byte", cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) - sum by (instance) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$node"})

panels.title: Memory usage by Node, all clusters, top 20

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (cluster, instance) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$node"}[5m])))

panels.title: CPU usage by Node, all clusters (cores)

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (cluster, instance) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$node"}))
